create_object_detection_pipeline: create an object detection pipeline using a pretrained model to predict bounding boxes and classes from images
run_object_detection_single_image: run object detection on a single image URL or local path and return detected objects with scores and bounding boxes
run_object_detection_batch_images: run object detection on a batch of images and return per-image lists of detected objects with labels and boxes
configure_detection_threshold: configure the detection threshold to filter predictions by minimum confidence score during postprocessing
use_layoutlm_token_classification: use LayoutLM token classification variant to classify OCR-extracted word boxes with bounding box coordinates
